verdict.rationale: Anytype exposes a localhost API, CLI headless server mode, and an official MCP/agent-skill integration that let external agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) run scripts against Anytype data programmatically, which enables building automations. However, there is no documented native scheduler, trigger system, or always-on background job runner within Anytype itself — automations still require an external agent/CLI process to be invoked rather than running autonomously on their own. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling/trigger mechanism, evidence of persistent background execution without an external agent invoking it, independent confirmation of autonomous runs.
